title: ProcureFlow
subtitle: B2B procurement platform
description: A full-stack platform for supplier discovery, RFQs, quotation comparison and purchase-order tracking, with organization-scoped access and responsive client/supplier workspaces.
architecture: Feature-oriented modular monolith with controller/service/repository layers and a separate frontend deployment
modules: Procurement: RFQs, quotations, awards, orders, queues and analytics
methodology: Iterative vertical slices, requirement-to-test traceability and review using an adapted Agile V workflow.
limits: In-memory sessions require additional design before multi-instance deployment.
AI extraction and supplier scoring are not implemented.
